caseNameFull: Phillips v. Baltimore & Ohio Railroad Co. and Crozier v. Baltimore & Ohio Railroad Co.
attorneys: Abe Fortas and Milton V. Freeman for petitioners in No. 1220., Harold C. Ackert and John W. Giesecke for petitioners in No. 1221., Arthur H. Dean, DeLano Andrews, Harry N.
